text:
This guide will help you navigate the different sources of information on the recognition of professional qualifications in the EU.

It also helps you understand:

when recognition of professional qualifications is required in an EU member state

where to find details around EU member state regulatory processes for your profession

where preferential routes to recognition may be available for UK professionals

what useful additional steps can be undertaken to help get your qualifications recognised

For more information, see:

information on selling services to EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein

Article 158 and Annex 24 of the UK-EU TCA which includes a provision enabling profession-specific recognition agreements

guidance for regulators and professional bodies on entering into recognition arrangements with counterparts
